title: Legend of Zelda maker type thing?
author: _BurnTheFed
selftext:
Kind of like Mario maker but for Zelda type games? You can set up quests, npc builder with dialogue, dungeon designer. You can set switches and triggers and wire them to what you need. Etc. 

HOW DO YOU GUYS GET YOUR GAMES TO LOOK SO GOOD? This has been a struggle for the “links awakening” toy diorama look.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: most people use tripo and also buy assets

comments.author: NagatoKami
comments.body: You've made all of this and at the end defaulted to Claude's generic yellow UI. Generate images with UI designs which will suite the game. Look out in the sub and you'll see hundreds and hundreds of the same UIs.

replies.author: _BurnTheFed
replies.body:
I havnt addressed the ui yet. I was just focusing more on making it fun and working. Then I was going to try and make everything look better. 

Idc what anything looks like until I know it’s actually fun to play with. If that makes any sense. But I appreciate the heads up on the ui.
